disease.description: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by developmental delay and regression, intellectual disability, severe disturbance of expressive and cognitive speech, intractable seizures, movement disturbances, severe depletion of creatine and phosphocreatine in the brain, and accumulation of guanidinoacetic acid in brain and body fluids.
